name: @octocodeai/octocode-benchmark
description: Benchmark suites for Octocode tools and engine behavior.

scripts.build: echo 'Source-only benchmark package; no build artifacts required'
scripts.lint: python3 -c "import ast,sys; [ast.parse(open(f).read(), f) for f in sys.argv[1:]]" compare/bin/*.py skills/octocode-benchmark/dashboard/*.py && bash -n compare/bin/run_arm.sh && bash -n compare/bin/run_campaign.sh && bash -n compare/bin/judge_pair.sh && bash -n compare/bin/preflight.sh && bash -n compare/bin/ghc && bash -n compare/bin/guard/gh
scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s compare/bin -p 'test_*.py' && node --test compare/bin/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test
